lxc_e4030f380d736649.text: Basketball is a team sport with two teams, one ball, and a high hoop.

lxc_0319a8840ffc805c.text: James Naismith made the game in 1891, and today the NBA and stars like Michael Jordan make it famous.

lxc_47f7bac3e7917152.text: Two teams play in one game.

lxc_d454dfb0a69dd410.text: Each team has five players on the court.

lxc_23c6ac47d5531390.text: The court is the floor where they play.

lxc_79e9dc49d449ec56.text: The two teams share one ball.

lxc_54d4409ffbca58d7.text: Players bounce the ball, pass the ball, and run with it.

lxc_81808a614510bb01.text: Each team tries to shoot the ball through a hoop.

lxc_d8b10a684b44432f.text: A hoop is a basket on a backboard.

lxc_c3c664cb5e3d1f81.text: The backboard is a flat board behind the basket.

lxc_aa855fc31b010d1e.text: The ball goes down through the hoop, and the team is happy.

lxc_b0ad62b66d4ac8dc.text: A shot that goes through the hoop is a field goal.

lxc_522bd802cd8abe34.text: A field goal is worth two points.

lxc_ee359467d99e1aa9.text: There is a big line on the court.

lxc_09b96e7657e20ad8.text: A shot from behind this line is worth three points.

lxc_92d59c56ac5877aa.text: So a close shot gives two points, and a far shot gives three points.

lxc_7ed491b7222f4811.text: The team with more points at the end wins the game.

lxc_48ea46485119e16b.text: Points make the game fast and fun to watch.

lxc_90970b287eaf51fa.text: He made it in Springfield, a city in Massachusetts.

lxc_966634027a3ec34a.text: The first game was on December 21, 1891.

lxc_438720657f75794d.text: A gym is warm and dry in winter, so a ball game inside a gym was a good idea.

lxc_e19bc3b7a23ad8cd.text: Many school gyms today still have a hoop on each wall.

lxc_cc2b89d1172acd46.text: A school gym in Japan often has them too.

lxc_73f12d25aee08911.text: Many people play basketball for fun.

lxc_907500ab18ecb8c4.text: Some people play in a big league.

lxc_6652a78470d6ebb8.text: A league is a group of teams that play each other.

lxc_215fc7b734243b0b.text: The National Basketball Association is a big basketball league.

lxc_a766ea93b68ae5c9.text: NBA games are on TV in many countries.

lxc_83035e96ef3cfd94.text: Fans watch the best players run, jump, and shoot.

lxc_cc6d1325540ff427.text: The NBA is one big reason people all over the world know basketball.

lxc_701e97122af2c0e9.text: Michael Jordan is a famous basketball player.

lxc_bf850be71f28314c.text: His full name is Michael Jeffrey Jordan.

lxc_995ba953269bf21a.text: He played 15 seasons in the NBA between 1984 and 2003.

lxc_85059e1d1a4e34b5.text: He played for the Chicago Bulls.

lxc_ce258fe29d9e20bf.text: He won six NBA championships with the Chicago Bulls.

lxc_a8903170636fea29.text: In the 1995-96 season, the Chicago Bulls had 72 regular-season wins.

lxc_936646da6a891019.text: That was a record at that time.

lxc_b6fdae75283df913.text: He jumped very high, so fans called him Air Jordan and His Airness.

lxc_1596a5982424d8bc.text: You need one ball and one hoop.

lxc_eb308d4fa9fee5f8.text: You do not need a big field.

lxc_862b2a44121cf1a7.text: A small park court or a school gym is enough.

lxc_f9f9dacece83f93e.text: You can play with one friend or with ten friends.

lxc_f0f0deab26e34e3d.text: The ball moves up and down the court all the time.

lxc_07aad16a833ccf59.text: Points come often, so there is always something to see.

lxc_a8ce25b512945e23.text: For many people, this is why basketball is fun to play and fun to watch.
